adopted: S03 distinguish brief urging from sustained blockage
S04 original satisfaction cannot contain new need
S05 explain failure of original support, not just afterglow
remove absence of new indication and future relationship certainty
qualify temporary comfort and add explicit H2/H3 dependence

main_critic_disposition.not_adopted: No blanket ban on a concrete initial concern: formal Center-last does not forbid a supported light starting situation. Both re-reviewers accept the new accumulation.

S04.premise: H2、H3确立当下亲近曾足以暂时安慰，H4使需要超出当下；不是一贯毫无疑虑的安心。
S04.invented: 不增具体事件、往事或对方回应；再次亲近是熟悉感重现，不断言两次外部相伴事件。
S04.note: 同样的温柔因新增延续需要而改变作用，解释第二次迫切；暂时安定的修辞保留了早先尚未消失的慎重与惜时。

S05.premise: H2、H3为早先暂时安慰的直接根据，H4为超出当下的需要，H5、H6为充分投入仍无延续保证；已显式补足H2/H3依赖。
S05.invented: 没有增加对方离开或冷淡的事件；安慰只曾暂时成立，不是持续无条件安心。
S05.note: 原支撑是正在发生的亲近给出暂时安慰，新增需要使其容量不够，更多自己的热切亦不能补足；因而不是普通激情退去的空虚。真实性闪念是同一失去依托的相容侧面，不强造独立疑问。

comparison_C25b: Not accepted for continuation despite legacy global ok=true: global problems nonempty; S03 leaves acute urgency unexplained, S04 mostly strength increase, S05 remains generic fall from intensity. Raw files preserved.
future_review_guard: Any subsequent substantive criticism reopens this pilot and all affected descendants; no silent acceptance of downstream failures.

final_candidate_audit.main_disposition: Both model selection_acceptable true. S05 automated pass false solely because explicitly non-fatal qualifications were put in problems. Main read all three and keeps them as limitations, not a fatal omission. No main experience was reclassified by its role label alone.
final_candidate_audit.scope_limit: S05-B2 fleeting authenticity doubt is compatible with H1 uncertainty rather than separately exhaustively derived; source does not claim every nuance is complete.

comparison_C25a: Not accepted for continuation: legacy process imported the older global gate before correction, so its raw ok=true coexists with substantive problems. S04 invents discovering uncertainty has not reduced liking, mostly repeats increased preciousness, and S05 remains generic afterglow. Both raw authors are retained as comparison, not silently pruned. Calibrated local success alone does not override old-value regression.
legacy_global_flag_disposition: C25a/C25b were launched before global ok=true plus problems normalization was added. Main rejects both on the stated reasons; current editor and full trials use the corrected gate.
